# Starlight Technology

> Buying intelligence and complete-system design for AI-native creators and small teams.

Canonical: https://starlight.technology
Methodology: https://starlight.technology/methodology
Disclosure: https://starlight.technology/disclosure
Sitemap: https://starlight.technology/sitemap.xml

## Editorial boundary

Every analysis declares whether evidence is owned-and-tested, hands-on, source-backed research, or decision-model inference. Research-only pages must not be represented as hands-on testing. Prices require a merchant/source, region, currency and verification timestamp.

## Main collections

- /ai — free AI System Brief Kit, deterministic setup planner and official software references
- /downloads/ai-system-brief.md — editable original system brief, available without account
- /downloads/ai-system-brief-example.md — fictional worked example, not customer evidence
- /downloads/ai-acceptance-worksheet.csv — acceptance and recovery run-record template
- /downloads/ai-agent-handoff.md — bounded implementation task template
- /shop — curated hardware, category filters, planning shortlists and constraints comparison
- /shop/[slug] — product identity, buying fit, complete-system checks and labelled merchant destination
- /partners — prospective supply and vendor relationships; no authorisation claimed

- /builds — complete systems by objective and planning budget
- /compare — constraint-led comparisons
- /guides — decision frameworks

## Commerce boundary

Hardware links lead directly to the official source until an approved, unexpired partner destination is configured. Affiliate links disclose commission beside the link and use rel=sponsored. No hardware checkout, customer orders, reseller authorisation or live merchant prices are active in this release. Never infer approval from a brand appearing in the shop.

The /ai collection offers original free planning material under CC BY 4.0. It does not distribute third-party software or model weights. Software references are ordinary official documentation links, with no commission. Paid AI editions are proposals, not available products. The setup planner is deterministic and its selections are not sent to an AI provider; downloading creates a text file on the visitor's device. No installation or compatibility certification is implied.
